zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空將率先在波音737 MAX 10配置平躺牀位
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空將在波音737 MAX 10配置平躺牀位，摘要列出12張Aurora座椅。
body: Simple Flying的標題稱，阿拉斯加航空將成為首家在波音737 MAX 10配置「真正平躺牀位」的航空公司。標題以未來式描述這項客艙安排，並將「首家」限定在該機型配置此類牀位的航空公司之中。
隨附摘要指出，該飛機將配置12張Aurora座椅。這是摘要列出的具體座椅數量與名稱；標題則說明阿拉斯加航空、波音737 MAX 10與平躺牀位之間的配置消息。

en.title: Alaska Airlines to Be First With Lie-Flat Bed on Boeing 737 MAX 10
en.summary: Alaska Airlines plans a lie-flat bed on the Boeing 737 MAX 10, with 12 Aurora seats.
body: Simple Flying’s headline says Alaska Airlines will be the first to put a “real lie-flat bed” on the Boeing 737 MAX 10. The wording presents this as a future cabin feature. The item’s accompanying summary identifies the aircraft’s planned seating fit as 12 Aurora seats.
Together, the headline and summary report a lie-flat-bed feature and a 12-seat Aurora fit for the named aircraft. The supplied summary does not give a date for the configuration to enter service.

zh.title: Shield AI與Honeywell完成兩項自主無人機協同飛行示範
zh.summary: Shield AI與Honeywell完成兩項自主無人機協同飛行示範
body: Shield AI與Honeywell Aerospace宣佈，雙方已完成兩項使用Shield AI Hivemind的自主飛行示範，並以兩架無人機執行協同情報、監視與偵察（ISR）任務。首場正式示範飛行於7月8日在明尼蘇達州Plymouth舉行；當次飛行中，無人機自行起飛、沿預定航線飛行，並繞過禁飛區後返回基地。
另一項協同ISR任務在Phoenix附近進行，兩架無人機使用Hivemind。其中一架偵測、識別並追蹤目標，再將資訊傳給第二架；第二架自主飛往目標、投放載荷，並與偵察機一同返回基地。

en.title: Shield AI and Honeywell complete two autonomous drone demonstrations
en.summary: Shield AI and Honeywell completed two autonomous drone demonstrations, including a coordinated two-aircraft ISR mission.
body: Shield AI and Honeywell Aerospace announced they had completed two autonomous flight demonstrations using Shield AI’s Hivemind, culminating in a coordinated intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) mission involving two aircraft. The first official demonstration flight took place on July 8 in Plymouth, Minnesota. The drone took off on its own, flew a planned route, rerouted around a no-fly zone and returned to base.

Another coordinated ISR mission took place near Phoenix, with two drones running Hivemind. One detected, identified and tracked a target, then passed the information to the second drone. The second autonomously flew to the target, delivered a payload and returned to base with the scout drone.

zh.title: 英國航空A321客艙窗戶裂痕後折返蓋特威克並安全降落
zh.summary: 英國航空A321機組回報客艙窗戶裂痕，航班折返蓋特威克並安全降落
body: 英國航空一架空中巴士A321於飛往葡萄牙途中，因機組回報客艙窗戶裂痕而預防性折返倫敦蓋特威克。報導指出，BA2660航班原定飛往Faro，從蓋特威克起飛約一小時後折返；機組曾發出表示一般緊急狀況的7700應答機代碼。
英國航空將事件描述為「輕微」技術問題。報導表示，航機安全降落在蓋特威克，航空公司正協助乘客繼續行程。客艙窗戶損壞的性質與程度尚未公開。

en.title: British Airways Airbus A321 returns to Gatwick after cracked window report
en.summary: British Airways returned to Gatwick after a cracked window report; the aircraft landed safely.
body: A British Airways Airbus A321 made a precautionary return to London Gatwick after crew reported a cracked passenger window during a flight to Portugal. Flight BA2660 was en route to Faro and turned back roughly an hour into the flight after departing Gatwick. The crew transmitted squawk 7700, a standard transponder code used to indicate a general emergency.

British Airways described the incident as a “minor” technical issue. The aircraft landed safely at Gatwick, and the airline said it was working to help passengers resume their journeys. The nature and extent of the damage to the passenger window have not been made public.

zh.title: 空中巴士評估擴大A350產能，預計近期決定
zh.summary: 空中巴士表示，近期將決定是否擴大A350產能，以回應航空公司對長程客機的需求。
body: 空中巴士商用飛機部門主管 Lars Wagner 於2026年10月14日在 Toulouse（法國）一場簡報中表示，公司預計近期決定是否擴大A350產能。Wagner說，相關投資仍須董事會批准；航空公司對更多長程客機的需求，是此項產能評估的背景。
Wagner表示，空中巴士現有A350組裝線的設計產能為每月12至13架；若要超過這個水準，將需要另一條生產線及額外製造產能。公司目前目標是在2028年達到每月生產12架A350，並於2026年7月的財務業績中重申此目標。

en.title: Airbus expects to decide soon on expanding A350 production capacity
en.summary: Airbus expects to decide soon on expanding A350 production capacity as airlines seek long-haul jets.
body: Airbus commercial aircraft chief Lars Wagner said on October 14, 2026, that the company expects to decide soon whether to expand A350 production capacity. Speaking at a briefing in Toulouse, France, Wagner said the investment would require board approval. Airlines are seeking more long-haul aircraft, the report said.

Airbus’s existing A350 assembly line was designed to produce 12 to 13 aircraft a month. Wagner said going beyond that rate would require another line and additional manufacturing capacity. The company already aims to build 12 A350s a month in 2028, a target it reaffirmed in its July 2026 financial results.
